summary: Canada Lookouts index lists a Bell lookout at 1264 m in the Kitimat-Stikine area; no source read gives its build date, staffing or fate.

facts.status_note: Only the index entry was found; no source says whether a tower stands at the site.

evidence.supports: Index lists the site under Kitimat-Stikine
Index gives the site as 56.351 N, 129.442 W, elevation 1264 m
Index entry is titled Bell under British Columbia lookouts

notes_for_editor: Story is about 50 words, under the 120-word floor, because the Canada Lookouts index is the only source that names this lookout. Two searches and the Bell II Wikipedia page (a Highway 37 locality named for the Bell-Irving River) gave nothing tying a lookout to the name; Bell II lies tens of kilometres from the index coordinates, so it was not used. The BC Tel Bell Irving page is a radio site on Bell Irving Mountain, not a lookout. Follow-up: BC Archives or Forest History Society search for a Bell lookout in Kitimat-Stikine, and the BC Forest Fire Lookouts group's coordinate list (compiled by John Parminter), which a search snippet mentioned but was not read.
